title: cephalanthus glabratus
intro: Cephalanthus glabratus, commonly known as the downy dogwood, is a shrub or small tree native to the southeastern United States. The downy dogwood is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, as well as its ability to treat fever, coughs, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Cephalanthus glabratus include its antimicrobial, antiviral, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in treating wounds, skin infections, and other conditions. The bioactive constituents of the downy dogwood include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
